*Two*

**Namo buddhassa**

**Literal:** Homage to [the] Buddha  
**Faithful:** Homage to the Buddha.  

| Word | Analysis & Meaning |
| :--- | :--- |
| **`namo`** | `(ind)` homage; **[namo]** |
| **`buddhassa`** | `(masc gen sg)` of the Buddha; **[√budh + ta]** |

**Buddhaṁ saraṇaṁ gacchāmi**

**Literal:** [The] Buddha [as] refuge I go [to]  
**Faithful:** I go to the Buddha for refuge.  

| Word | Analysis & Meaning |
| :--- | :--- |
| **`buddhaṁ`** | `(masc acc sg)` to the Buddha; **[√budh + ta]** |
| **`saraṇaṁ`** | `(nt acc sg)` refuge; **[√sar + aṇa]** |
| **`gacchāmi`** | `(1st sg pres act indic)` I go; **[√gam + a + mi]** |

**Buddho bhagavā**

**Literal:** [The] Buddha [the] Blessed One  
**Faithful:** the Buddha, the Blessed One.  

| Word | Analysis & Meaning |
| :--- | :--- |
| **`buddho`** | `(pp masc nom sg)` awakened; **[√budh + ta]** |
| **`bhagavā`** | `(masc nom sg)` the Blessed One; **[√bhaj + a + vant]** |
